name: Amoonguna
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Recreation Hall. Active 24\7.
road_access_comment: Amoonguna is 20 km from Alice Springs off the Ross Highway with a sealed access road. Heavy and consistent rainfall can flood the Todd River and community access may be cut for a short period.

name: Ampilatwatja
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Basketball Court. Monday - Thursday: 9am - 8pm. Friday: 9am-9pm. Not active on weekends.
road_access_comment: Ampilatwatja is approx. 315 km south east of Tennant Creek (155 km unsealed) and approx. 325 km north east of Alice Springs, off the Sandover Highway (220 km unsealed). It's about 4 hours' drive if the road is in reasonable condition. A 4-WD is required during rainy weather and the road can be impassable or closed to all vehicles with heavy rain.

name: Areyonga
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Rec Hall. Available 10am-9pm Mon-Thurs, 10am-7pm Fri, 10am-9pm Sat. Not available Sun.
road_access_comment: The access road consists of sealed road from Alice Springs to Gosses Bluff Juction (185 km), then dirt road to Areyonga (55 km). The dirt part of the road is often quite rough with corrugations. A few creek crossings make the road impassable in fairly extreme wet conditions. Caution required at 'Devils Elbow' at approach to creek crossing accessing community entry point. It takes about 2.5 hours to drive there.

name: Orrtipa-Thurra
wifi_comment: Serviced by Activ8me. For support ring 13 22 88

name: Engawala
wifi_comment: WiFi hotspot and computer room have been set up in community by CAYLUS . Separate WiFi is provided and serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88
road_access_comment: Engawala is 180 km from Alice Springs. The Plenty Highway is sealed for 110 kms, turn left onto unsealed Delmore Downs Road for 28 km, left to Engawala.

name: Finke
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Rec Hall. 3pm-8pm Tues-Sat. Not available Sun & Mon.
road_access_comment: Travel from Alice Springs via the Stuart Highway to Kulgera Roadhouse, (270 km), turn left via the Finke Road to Finke (147 km, all dirt road. Always check road conditions prior to travel. Erldunda Roadhouse, (200 km from Alice) and Kulgera Roadhouse are available for fuel and food.

name: Haasts Bluff
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Rec Hall. Available 24hrs, 7 days. Separate WiFi is provided and serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88
road_access_comment: Haasts Bluff is 227 km west of Alice Springs via Larapinta Drive and the Namatjira Kintore Link Road, or 257 km via the Tanami Highway and then turn onto Papunya/Kintore road.

name: Atitjere
wifi_comment: Available 24hours, 7 days.
road_access_comment: Atitjere is approx 215 km from Alice Springs on the Plenty Highway. The highway is sealed from the Stuart Highway to Atitjere. Work is progressing on sealing the road past the turn off.

name: Hermannsburg
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Rec Hall. Tuesday to Thursday 0830am-10:00pm, Friday 0830am-10:30pm, Saturday 0830am-6pm, Sunday & Monday turned off
road_access_comment: The 130 km access road to the community from Alice Springs is along Larapinta Drive, and is sealed the entire distance. It's around 1.5 hrs drives from Alice Springs, however can be cut off due to heavy rain for short periods.

name: Imanpa
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Learning Centre. Available 24hours, 7 days.
road_access_comment: The community is accessible by road (Lasseters Highway) from Alice Springs. The Lasseters Highway is sealed to the community turn off.

name: Kaltukatjara
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Shiny Shed, Lot 141. 11am-9pm daily.
road_access_comment: Alice Springs to Docker River is 670 km via Uluru. The 183 km from the Olgas is unsealed. The community is on the Outback Way. It's approximately 7 hours drive from Alice Springs.

name: Kintore
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Youth Centre. Separate WiFi is provided and serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88
stand_comment: Located at Yirara College and Walunguru School
road_access_comment: By road, road the community is 530km from Alice Springs. The first part (136 km) of road travel is via a bitumen all-weather Tanami Highway. The remainder of the journey is via dirt roads of varying quality.

name: Laramba
wifi_comment: WiFi hotspot and computer room have been set up in community by CAYLUS . Separate WiFi is provided and serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88
road_access_comment: The Community is 205 km by road from Alice Springs. Access to the community from Alice Springs is via the Napperby station road, which runs west from the Stuart Highway, 122 km north of Alice Springs. The community is located 83km from the turnoff. It takes 2.5 hours to drive there.

name: Mount Liebig
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Youth Centre. Available 24/7.
road_access_comment: The community is located 325 km west of Alice Springs via the Tanami Highway and Kintore Roads.

name: Mutitjulu
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Rec Hall. 8am-8pm daily.
road_access_comment: Mutitjulu is located 470 km southwest by road from Alice Springs. The community can is accessible all year round by road (sealed) via Lasseter Highway (Alice Springs to Yulara) and Uluru Road (Yulara to Mutitjulu).

name: Nturiya
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Library (Council Building). 1pm-4pm Mon-Fri, 9am-4pm Sat. Not available Sun.
road_access_comment: The community is around 210 km north of Alice Springs by road via the Stuart Highway, 16 km west of Ti Tree. The entire road to Ti Tree is sealed, and takes two hours to drive there.

name: Nyirripi
wifi_comment: WiFi hotspot and computer room have been set up in community by CAYLUS . Separate WiFi is provided and serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88
road_access_comment: From Alice Springs travel via the Tanami Highway to Yuendumu, (293 km, 285 km sealed). Turn left opposite Yuendumu via the Nyirripi Road. Nyirripi is 150 km of dirt road. Always check the road conditions prior to travel. The Tilmouth Well Roadhouse is 188 km from Alice Springs for fuel and food.

name: Papunya
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Maku Shed.
road_access_comment: The community is accessible via the Tanami Highway and Kintore road from Alice Springs. It is located 240 km west of Alice Springs.

name: Pmara Jutunta
road_access_comment: The community is around 190 km from Alice Springs by road on the Stuart Highway. It takes 2 hours to drive there. The community is situated approximately 500 metres to the east of the Stuart Highway.

name: Santa Teresa
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Rec Hall. Tuesday ¿ Saturday 3pm ¿ 10pm (Standard hours) / Tuesday ¿ Saturday 8am ¿ 10pm (School holidays) - Disabled Mondays & Sundays
stand_comment: Located at the Ltyentye Apurte Catholic School
road_access_comment: The community is located 85 km from Alice Springs by road and it takes approx 1 hour to drive there. The access road to the community consists of sealed road (50%) and unsealed gravel road. The road is passable for conventional vehicles at most times. A few creek crossings make the road impassable in fairly extreme wet conditions.

name: Titjikala
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Rec Hall (Lot 109). Available 24/7.
road_access_comment: The community is located 130 km south east of Alice Springs via the Old South Road. It takes approx 1.5 hours to drive there. The road from Alice Springs is mostly unsealed. Access is generally available to conventional vehicles, however the road becomes impassable after heavy rains.

name: Wallace Rockhole
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Council Office, 18 Roesch St. Available 24 hours, 7 days.
road_access_comment: The access road to the community consists of 100 km of sealed road from Alice Springs and then 20 km of graded dirt road. It takes 1.5 hours to drive there. The road is passable for conventional vehicles at most times though it is rough in the wet. In extreme weather the road is impassable and the town can become isolated.

name: Willowra
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Willowra Activity Centre, CDP building, 9 Pawu St. 9am-3pm Mon-Fri, not available Sat & Sun.
road_access_comment: The community is located off the Stuart Highway 340 km north, north west of Alice Springs. Travel up the Stuart Highway towards Tennant Creek, and turn off highway 15 km north of Ti Tree, travel 130km north-west to the community.

name: Wilora
road_access_comment: The community is located 245 km north of Alice Springs. Sighnposted - turn off East of the Stuart Highway, only a short distance from the Highway.

name: Yuelamu
wifi_comment: Serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88
road_access_comment: The access road to the community from Alice Springs is via the Tanami Highway off the Stuart Highway. The road from the Stuart Highway to the Mt Allen turnoff is sealed. From there it is 31 km unformed gravel road to the community. From the Tanami Highway the road is subject to washaways during heavy rainfall.

name: Yuendumu
road_access_comment: The access road to the community from Alice Springs is along the Tanami Highway, which branches off the Stuart Highway 25 km North of Alice Springs. It takes approximately 3 hours to drive there. The road is sealed all way to Yuendumu.

name: Ali Curung
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Rec Hall. 12:30pm-9:30pm Mon-Fri. Not available Sat & Sun.
road_access_comment: The community is located 170 km south of Tennant Creek. The road from Tennant Creek to Ali Curung is sealed and is roughly a 2 hr drive.

name: Alpurrurulam
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Community Centre. 2:30pm-10pm Mon-Fri, 8am-10pm Sat & Sun. Separate WiFi is provided and serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88
road_access_comment: Alpurrurulam is approx. 570 km east from Tennant Creek along the Barkly Highway via the Austral Downs Station road turnoff approx. 11 km from the NT/QLD border. In the wet season the road, and the river can become impassable. Alpurrurulam can also be accessed via the Sandover Highway.

name: Canteen Creek
wifi_comment: Serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88
road_access_comment: The community is located approx. 275 km south east of Tennant Creek. 85 km south along the Stuart Highway is the turn off, then 190 km east along a dirt road past Wutunugurra (Epenarra) community. It is approx. a 3.5 hours drive from Tennant Creek.

name: Wutunugurra
wifi_comment: Serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88
road_access_comment: The community is located on the western side of the Frew River, 205km south-east of Tennant Creek. Access road consists of both sealed and unsealed sections (around 87km of sealed along the Stuart Highway to the Wutunugurra turn off and 118km of unsealed along the Kurundi Road). Access to the community is variable, depending on weather conditions the Kurundi Road may be closed due to flooding in the wet season.

name: Mungkarta
wifi_comment: Serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88

name: Imangara
road_access_comment: By road, the community is located 207 km south of Tenant Creek. Turn off Ali Curung road opposite workshop - 35km to Murray Down Station. First 170km section of the road is sealed and the later part is unsealed.

name: Robinson River
stand_comment: Located at the Robinson River School
internet_comment: Telstra Small Cell 4G Network connectivity is permanently available
road_access_comment: By road, the trip to Robinson River takes approx 10 hours from Katherine. The double lane Stuart Highway is sealed the entire way. At Daly Waters, the Carpentaria Highway be followed to Borroloola. This is a single lane Highway. The remaining 150 km is dirt road. It is recommend to travel in a 4WD.

name: Tara
wifi_comment: Serviced by Activ8me, for support ring 13 22 88
road_access_comment: The community is located about 220 km south of Tennant Creek. About 8km off the Stuart Highway and access is via an unsealed road to Neutral Junction Station, then 2km on to the community.

name: Belyuen
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Council Office. Available 24hours, 7 days.
road_access_comment: The community is located on the eastern side of Cox Peninsula approx 128 km by road from Darwin. The road from Darwin to Belyuen is sealed.

name: Gunbalanya
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Youth Centre. 7am-9pm daily.
stand_comment: Located at the Gunbalanya Youth Centre
road_access_comment: By road, the community is approx 330 km from Darwin. The main road leading to Gunbalanya from Darwin to Cahills Crossing (East Alligator River) is sealed; and the road from Cahills Crossing to Gunbalanya is formed gravel. The later part of the road is impassable at times during wet season.

name: Maningrida
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Swimming Pool Lot 467. 7am-6pm Daily.
road_access_comment: Access to Maningrida via a sealed road to Cahills Crossing, and a dirt road for a further 250 km (4WD recommended but not essential). During the wet season access is limited, with the road often closed for extended periods. The drive takes approximately seven hours from Darwin.

name: Milikapiti
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Library, Lot 247. 8am-6pm daily (currently offline).
road_access_comment: No Mainland Access. Accessible via Aerodrome or Snake Bay Barge Landing

name: Minjilang
road_access_comment: Only Accessible by Air or Barge

name: Nauiyu
wifi_comment: Centrelink public WiFi, available in the vicinity of the council office.
stand_comment: Located at St Francis Xavier Catholic School
road_access_comment: It takes 2.5-3 hours to drive Nauiyu from Darwin. The entire road to the community is sealed, however during the wet season flooding of the Daly River can severely affect the community which can be cut off for several weeks.

name: Wurrumiyanga
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Sports and Recreation Hall Lot 834. 8am-6pm daily
stand_comment: Located at the Murrupurtiyanuwu Catholic Primary School
road_access_comment: No Mainland Access. Accessible via Aerodrome or Bathurst Island Barge Landing

name: Nganmarriyanga
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Council Office. 8am-8pm Mon-Sat, not available Sun.
road_access_comment: By road the community is 375 km from Darwin on the Port Keats Road between the communities of Peppimenarti and Wadeye. The Palumpa access road is unsealed and approx 140 km from the Daly River Bridge. The community is cut off during the wet season for extended period. The road between Palumpa and Port Keats, though only 45km away, is also impassable during the wet season.

name: Peppimenarti
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Council Office. 8am-8pm Mon-Sat, not available Sun.
road_access_comment: The community located approx 320 km south east of Darwin, is accessible by road. It is 120 km west of the Daly River crossing, along the Port Keats road. The access road consists of both sealed (upto Daly River Crossing) and unsealed sections. During the wet season the unsealed section of the road becomes impassable and access often limited to plane.

name: Pirlangimpi
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Library. 8am-6pm daily.
road_access_comment: No Mainland Access. Accessible via Aerodrome or Garden Point Barge Landing

name: Wadeye
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the council offices. Mon - Sat 8am - 8pm; Sun Off
stand_comment: Located at OLSH Thamarrurr Catholic College
road_access_comment: By road, Wadeye is located approximately 420 km south west of Darwin. It is accessed along the Daly River Road which is not sealed from the Daly River crossing and can only be accessed during the Dry Season (May to October).

name: Warruwi
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Council Office. 8am-8pm daily.

name: Angurugu
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Library (Lot 348). 7am-5pm daily. Free WiFi is on the way for Angurugu: Free community Wi-Fi on the way - Angurugu
stand_comment: Located at the Angurugu Trade Training Centre and Angurugu School

name: Baniyala
stand_comment: Located at the Baniyala Garrangali School

name: Galiwinku
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Lot 120, Yawunymirringura St.
internet_comment: Ongoing issues with Telstra services. Island can lose telephone/internet provision for days at a time.

name: Gapuwiyak
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Creche, 13 Banbinamirri St. School Terms Monday to Friday: 2pm-7pm. Weekends 7am-5pm. School Holidays 7am-5pm Daily.
road_access_comment: Road access to Gapuwiyak, 4wd only, is via a turn-off from the Central Arnhem road about 200 km from Nhulunbuy. Travel time from Nhulunbuy is approximately 2.5 hours depending on road/weather conditions.

name: Gunyangara
road_access_comment: By road, the community is 13 km west of Nhulunbuy township. From Nhulunbuy CBD the community is accessible via Melville Bay Road, 8 km of sealed road, approximate travel time 10 mins.

name: Milingimbi
wifi_comment: There is free wifi at the Rulku Lodge for guests. Milingimbi is included in the Federal and Northern Territory Government funding package for the roll out of free Wifi in remote NT communities . Telstra has 3G and 4G coverage on the island.
stand_comment: Located at the Milingimbi Cyclone Shelter

name: Milyakburra
stand_comment: Located at the Milyakburra Community Centre Cyclone Shelter

name: Numbulwar
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Council Office. 8am-5pm daily.
road_access_comment: Numbulwar is approx 438 km East of Katherine. The community is accessible by road mostly during the dry season only from Katherine via the Roper River and Ngukurr communities. Travelling is difficult due to significant dirt sections with corrugations and water crossings. Roads may only be open for 4-5 months every year and then in varying conditions.

name: Ramingining
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Library, 21 Warrk Rd. Available 7am-5pm daily.
road_access_comment: The community is 435 km west of Nhulunbuy by road. It is accessible by road (4wd) however, all roads to the community are closed during the wet season. Travel time by road to Darwin and Nhulunbuy is 8 hours. Travel time from Nhulunbuy is approximately 6-8 hours depending on road/weather conditions.

name: Umbakumba
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Library, 12 Mamarika Rd. 7am-5pm daily.
stand_comment: Located at the Alyarrmandumanja Umbakumba School

name: Yirrkala
stand_comment: Located at Laynhapuy Homelands School, Yirrkala School and Mäpuru Yirralka College
road_access_comment: Yirrkala is 15 km southeast of Nhulunbuy by road. From Nhulunbuy CBD the community is accessible via the Central Arnhem Road. Travel time is approximately 15 mins.

name: Barunga
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Library, Barunga School (Lot 327). Available 7am-8pm Daily.
road_access_comment: The community is located 80 km south east of Katherine by road. It's approx an hour's drive. The single lane Central Arnhem Highway is sealed to the gateway of Barunga. Only during severe flooding which occurs only sporadically does the road become inaccessible.

name: Wugularr
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Council Office. Monday-Friday: 8am-4.30pm. Not available on weekends.
road_access_comment: By road, the community is located approximately 118 km south east of Katherine and 31 km east of Barunga. It's around 1.5 hours' drive from Katherine. The Central Arnhem Highway is sealed to the Wugularr Rubbish Dump, approximately 6km past Wugularr. Only during severe flooding which occurs only sporadically does the road become inaccessible.

name: Binjari
road_access_comment: The community is located approx 16 km southwest from Katherine off of the Victoria Highway.

name: Bulla
stand_comment: Located at the Bulla Camp School
road_access_comment: The community is situated on the Victoria Highway 340 km west of Katherine. The nearest small town is Timber Creek, a distance of 60 km east of Bulla Camp along the Victoria Highway.

name: Bulman
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Council Office. 8am-5pm daily.
road_access_comment: By road, the trip to Bulman takes approx four hours from Katherine. The Central Arnhem Highway is sealed to Wugularr Rubbish Dump (124km). The remaining 188 km is dirt road. The road becomes impassable at times during the wet season at Mainoru River and Flying Fox Creek.

name: Daguragu
wifi_comment: In the Sport and Rec Building. 6pm-10pm Daily.
road_access_comment: Access to Daguragu from Katherine is via the Victoria and Buntine highways. The road is sealed between the Victoria Highway turnoff and Kalkarindji, with the section between Kalkarindji and the Western Australia border unsealed. Depending on weather and road conditions, it is about a five to six hours drive. Kalkarindji and Daguragu are about 8kms apart and connected by Daguragu Road, which is sealed. The Wattie Creek causeway can close for periods during the wet season, restricting access between Kalkarindji and Daguragu.

name: Jilkminggan
road_access_comment: By road, the trip to Jilkminggan takes approx 1.5 hours from Katherine. The double lane Stuart Highway is sealed in its entirety as is the single lane Roper Highway that links Jilkminggan to the Stuart Highway approx 10 km south of Mataranka.

name: Manyallaluk
road_access_comment: By road, it takes just over an hour to drive from Katherine to Manyallaluk. Heading south turn onto the Central Arnhem Highway (sign posted as Barunga/Beswick/Nhulunbuy) and drive to the Manyallaluk turn off, approximately 16km. Travel for 37 km on dirt road to Manyallaluk community. During wet season the dirt road can be closed for a few days due to flooding.

name: Kalkarindji
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Council Office. 24hours, 7 days.
road_access_comment: Access to Kalkarindji from Katherine is via the Victoria and Buntine highways. The road is sealed between the Victoria Highway turnoff and Kalkarindji, with the section between Kalkarindji and the Western Australia border unsealed. Depending on weather and road conditions, it is about a five to six hours drive.

name: Kybrook Farm
road_access_comment: The community of is located 8 km south of Pine Creek Township by road and is accessible all year round by road.

name: Lajamanu
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Library (Batchelor Institute Learning Centre). 9am-3pm Daily.
road_access_comment: By road, Lajamanu can be accessed from Katherine and from Alice Springs. From Katherine, access is via the sealed Buntine Highway and then via approximately 100 km of unsealed road. The travel time is around 6 hours. Access can also be made from Alice Springs via the Tanami Road, which is currently sealed from Alice Springs to within 8 km from Yuendumu, then via the Lajamanu Road. The unsealed section of the Tanami Road as well as the unsealed Lajamanu Road are often in poor repair. The distance from Alice Springs is approx 880 km.

name: Amanbidji
road_access_comment: The community is serviced by an unsealed road to the Victoria Highway (62 km). Once on the Highway it is 107 km east to Timber Creek, the nearest settlement in the Northern Territory.

name: Minyerri
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the "Corporation Office" Lot 69. 8am-11pm daily.
road_access_comment: By road, the trip to Minyerri takes approx three hours from Katherine. Following the sealed partly single lane Roper Highway which is approx 110 km from Mataranka for 40 km to the Minyerri/Hodgson Downs turn-off. The remaining 40 km is dirt road.

name: Ngukurr
wifi_comment: In the vicinity of the Council Office (Lot 293). Available Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:30pm, Saturday & Sunday off.
road_access_comment: Access to Ngukurr by road uses the Roper Highway which is single and double lane bitumen. The last 70km into Ngukurr is well maintained gravel, which can be used by conventional cars during the dry season and 4WD during the wet season. Travel time by road is approximately 3.5 hours from Katherine. New bridges built over the Roper and Wilton Rivers reduce the impact of severe flooding. When flooded, the road is inaccessible.

name: Nitjpurru
road_access_comment: The community is located about 450 km from Katherine by road. It can be accessed via road; 4WD only.

name: Rittarangu
road_access_comment: Rittarangu is located approx 300 km southeast of Katherine, using the Roper Highway which is single and double lane bitumen. The last 50km into Rittarangu is gravel. The new bridge built over the Roper River reduces the duration of severe flooding. When flooded, the road is inaccessible.

name: Weemol
road_access_comment: By road, the trip to Weemol takes approx four hours from Katherine. The single lane Central Arnhem Highway is sealed to the Beswick Rubbish Dump, approximately 124 km from the Stuart Highway. The remaining 194 km is dirt road. The road does become inaccessible at times during most wet seasons at Mainoru River and Flying Fox Creek.

name: Yarralin
road_access_comment: Access from Katherine is via the Victoria Highway and then through the picturesque Jasper Gorge, often impassable during the wet season. Alternative access is via the Buntine Highway through Top Springs. Apart from the Victoria Highway all roads are unsealed and often rocky. It takes around 4 hours to drive there from Katherine.
